title: Light Settles Here
description:
以沉靜而溫暖的生活氛圍作為設計起點。

屋主偏好安定、內斂的空間感受，因此牆面選擇較深的暖米色，搭配胡桃木家具、自然織品與柔和燈光，讓不同材質與色調在空間中形成細膩的層次。風格上則汲取 Zara Home 與 Ferm Living 所呈現的生活美學，在簡潔的線條中融入自然材質與帶有雕塑感的家具家飾。

考量客廳尺度有限，為了區隔冰箱與電器櫃，同時減少設備對主要生活空間的視覺干擾，我們以胡桃木色的 L 型牆面重新梳理空間關係。牆面高度控制在 200 公分，刻意不延伸至天花板，使視線與空間感得以延續；轉角則透過柔和的弧形收邊，減少量體的銳利感。

在有限的尺度裡，不以過多的裝修填滿空間，而是透過色彩、材質與比例的細緻拿捏，讓機能與美感自然共存，形塑一處沉靜、舒適且富有生活溫度的居所。


A quiet and inviting atmosphere forms the starting point of this home.

Inspired by the homeowners' preference for calm, understated interiors, a deeper shade of warm beige was chosen for the walls, complemented by walnut furnishings, natural textiles, and soft lighting. Drawing inspiration from the lifestyle aesthetics of Zara Home and Ferm Living, the design brings together clean lines, organic materials, and sculptural accents to create a warm yet refined living environment.

With a compact living area, a walnut-toned L-shaped partition was introduced to visually separate the refrigerator and appliance storage from the main living space. Standing at just 200 cm, the partition stops short of the ceiling, preserving a sense of openness and continuity. Its softly rounded corner further softens the architectural form.

Rather than filling the space with unnecessary details, the design focuses on a thoughtful balance of color, material, and proportion, allowing function and aesthetics to coexist naturally in a home that feels calm, comfortable, and lived in.
